catalyst_observation.source_statement: Topline results from the CATALINA Phase 2 trial of NGM621 in geographic atrophy: 'Trial did not meet primary endpoint of statistically significant rate of change in GA lesion area using slope analysis over 52 weeks for NGM621 versus sham.' A clean, standalone negative trial-failure headline; the favorable safety/tolerability sub-bullet is standard trial reporting, not a reframing of the primary miss.
